name: Strike Lab - Fighting Game Training Arena

Include a humanoid training dummy, a three-hit light-attack combo with visible windup, contact and recovery animations, synchronized hit sound effects, a visible accepted-hit counter and dummy health. A damage script with a static dummy does not meet the animation requirement.

spec.title: Strike Lab - Fighting Game Training Arena
spec.summary: Strike Lab is a single-player fighting game training arena designed for desktop and touch devices. Upon spawning in a sleek, minimalist training dojo arena, the player faces a humanoid training dummy positioned on a sparring ring. Players execute a 3-hit light attack combo (Jab, Cross, Roundhouse Kick) with clear telegraph/windup, active contact window, and recovery phases. The server strictly validates attack cadence, combo chaining timing, and spatial strike distance. Hits register damage and increment an accepted-hit counter exactly once during contact frames, while swings out of range or spamming during recovery produce distinct whiff/miss feedback without dealing damage or registering combo hits. When the dummy's health depletes, it plays a defeat reaction, pauses briefly, and automatically resets, while a dedicated manual reset button is also available in the HUD. The client provides intuitive desktop (M1/F key) and touch (on-screen Strike button) controls with live visual combo counters, dummy health bar, and floating combat text.
spec.visualDirection: High-contrast modern fighting gym/cyber-dojo aesthetic with clean neon arena bounds, dark carbon flooring, sparring boundary decals, and focused overhead studio spotlights. The training dummy stands centered on an elevated octagonal sparring pad with an overhead floating health bar and hit counter HUD. Attacks trigger distinct visual cues: punch trails and bright impact sparks on accepted contact, swift air whoosh effects on misses, and dynamic damage numbers bouncing upward.
